action.name: action
action.instructions: What does the current player want to do? Choose narrateValues when they ask about the state of the game. Choose nextHand to deal the next hand after a hand has finished. Choose pickWinner when a showdown pot is waiting to be awarded. Choose undo only for a clear request to undo the last confirmed turn. Choose nothing for background chatter or unclear speech.

bet.description: Make a bet with the stated amount.

cardsDealt.description: The requested physical cards have been dealt.

undo.description: Undo the most recent change to the game.

pickWinner.description: Award the current showdown pot to the winning player or players.

narrateValues.description: Report one or more state values the player asked to hear.

nothing.description: Background chatter, unrelated speech, or unclear speech.

raiseTarget.name: raise_target
raiseTarget.instructions: If the player is raising or betting, did they mean a total for the round (raiseTo) or an amount on top of the call (raiseBy)?

raiseTo.description: The number is the total the player wants to have bet this round.

raiseBy.description: The number is on top of the amount needed to call.

winner.instructions: Did {name} win this pot? Choose yes for every player who won the pot; if more than one player won, split the pot between them.

yes.description: Yes, this player won (or tied for) the pot.

no.description: No, this player did not win.

amount.instructions: In the {field} the user stated, what digit is in the {place} place?

values.instructions: Does the user want to know {label}?
